aria: Heads-up: canary hit OOMs during eager hotstart for mixed safetensors + gz shards. Loader assumes fixed offsets; compressed shards break mmap layout.

josh: Minimal log?

aria: 
2026-03-18T15:02:31Z WARN warmup: hotstart failed: mmap read beyond shard bounds
model: mosaic-1.0 sharded(32) mixed-format
Repro: pytest tests/warmup/test_hotstart.py::test_mixed_shard_hotstart --eager-warmup

kai: Root cause: manifest lacks per-shard chunk layout. Our handoff is {shard_id,size,url,checksum} which isn't enough for mmap/hotstart.

maria: Proposal: optional manifest field `hotstart_layout` with per-shard chunk offsets and compression flags. Backward compatible; old loaders ignore it.

josh: Alternative: runtime probe shim that reads a small range to detect safetensors vs gzip. No manifest change but adds latency and depends on range support.

aria: Measured probe cost: ~0.2ms local, ~8-15ms remote per shard. For many shards that adds up. Also some CDNs don't honor range.

kai: Recommendation: manifest-first, probe-as-fallback behind feature flag.

maria: Rollout plan: 1) add optional `hotstart_layout` in manifest 2) loader consumes it when present 3) probe shim behind `EAGER_HOTSTART_PROBE` feature flag 4) canary.

ops-bot: Add metrics: warmup_failure_count, warmup_probe_latency_ms_p50_p95, hotstart_success_rate. Alert if warmup_failure_count > 5 in 1h.

aria: Pseudo for probe shim:
function detect_shard_format(url, shard_id, manifest=None):
  if manifest and manifest.hotstart_layout and shard_id in manifest.hotstart_layout:
    return manifest.hotstart_layout[shard_id]
  head = http_range_get(url, bytes=0-128)
  if b"safetensors" in head: return 'safetensors'
  if head.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"): return 'gzip'
  return 'unknown'

josh: Tests: expired presigned URLs, range-not-supported returns 200, truncated heads, S3 latency.

maria: Actions: aria->manifest PR + example bundles; kai->loader shim prototype; josh->test harness; ops->metrics & alerts. I'll open the PR and tag eng-ml. :thumbsup:
